edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary as approved by the Board and reflected in the Company's payroll records, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices, plus eligibility to participate in employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of such plans.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive's employment is terminated by the Company without Cause, then, subject to the Executive's execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims, the Executive shall receive severance equal to twelve months of the Executive's then-current base salary, payable in substantially equal installments over the twelve-month period following termination in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for twelve months following termination, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in activities that are competitive with the Company's business in any jurisdiction in which the Company conducts material business, except to the extent such restriction is prohibited by applicable law. The Executive shall also remain subject to customary confidentiality, non-solicitation, and invention assignment obligations.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $425,000, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company's annual incentive bonus program with a target annual bonus opportunity equal to 60% of annual base salary, subject to achievement of applicable Company and individual performance goals and the terms of the applicable plan or program. The Executive shall also be eligible to receive equity awards under the Company's equity incentive plans, as determined by the Board or its compensation committee and subject to the terms of the applicable plan and award agreements. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms and conditions of such plans.
edits.name: Section 2 revised compensation provision

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive's employment is terminated by the Company without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, then, subject to the Executive's execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims and continued compliance with the Executive's surviving obligations to the Company, the Executive shall receive: (a) severance equal to eighteen months of the Executive's then-current annual base salary, payable in substantially equal installments over the eighteen-month period following termination in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices; (b) an amount equal to one and one-half times the Executive's target annual bonus for the year of termination, payable in installments over the same eighteen-month period; and (c) if the Executive timely elects continuation coverage under COBRA, Company-paid or reimbursed COBRA premiums for the Executive and eligible dependents for up to eighteen months following termination, or until the Executive becomes eligible for comparable coverage from another employer, if earlier, in each case subject to applicable law and plan terms.
edits.name: Section 3 revised severance provision

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall remain subject to customary confidentiality, proprietary information, invention assignment, and return-of-property obligations during and after employment. During employment and for twelve months following termination, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly: (a) solicit or induce any employee, consultant, or independent contractor of the Company to terminate or materially reduce such person's relationship with the Company; or (b) solicit any customer, client, vendor, or business partner of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the twelve months preceding termination for the purpose of providing products or services that are competitive with those provided by the Company. No general post-employment non-compete shall apply except to the extent narrowly required to protect the Company's legitimate business interests and enforceable under applicable law.
edits.name: Section 4 narrowed restrictive covenants
